effectContract.compoundException: ${terms.technology.agentSwarm} is the only card that resolves additional Core Actions.

wildActions.name: ${terms.technology.megaCluster}
wildActions.displayName: The Building Has Its Own Weather
wildActions.text: Spend 3 ${terms.resources.runway} and 2 ${terms.resources.compute} to place a ${terms.technology.megaCluster} across an eligible Facility edge. For joint funding, the lead pays 2 ${terms.resources.runway} and 1 ${terms.resources.compute}; the partner pays 1 ${terms.resources.runway} and 1 ${terms.resources.compute}. It demands 2 additional ${terms.resources.power}, produces 3 ${terms.resources.compute}, and adds 2 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
wildActions.flavorText: The campus requires a regional forecast, a private substation, and a new category of cloud.
wildActions.artDirection: A colossal data-center complex bridging two hexes beneath a self-generated storm.
wildActions.absurdity: A single training facility becomes geography.

wildActions.name: Reorganization
wildActions.text: Move every Team up to one hex. You may return one Team for 3 ${terms.resources.runway} and add 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}. This does not ready or resolve another Action.
wildActions.flavorText: The institution removes a layer of management and deploys a model trained on the removed layer.
wildActions.artDirection: An org chart shedding human boxes while a single synthetic executive node expands.
wildActions.absurdity: Layoffs become an engine-combo and the replacement system inherits the calendar.

wildActions.name: Open Weights
wildActions.text: Every player gains 1 ${terms.resources.capability}. You gain 2 ${terms.resources.trust}, place 1 ${terms.actions.influence}, and remove 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
wildActions.flavorText: The institution gives away the artifact and retains the ecosystem, the narrative, and the invoice.
wildActions.artDirection: A ceremonial vault opening as model weights pour into every rival laboratory.
wildActions.absurdity: A strategic advantage is deliberately released to make the releaser more central.

wildActions.name: Narrative Capture
wildActions.text: Move or place 3 ${terms.actions.influence} among Media, Government, and Capital, then remove 2 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}, gain 2 ${terms.resources.runway}, or add 1 ${terms.resources.scrutiny} to a player with more ${terms.resources.customers}.
wildActions.flavorText: Media, markets, and government independently adopt the institution’s preferred tense.
wildActions.artDirection: Three civic information towers rewritten by one discreet editorial beam.
wildActions.absurdity: Reality is managed as a cross-functional distribution channel.

wildActions.name: ${terms.technology.agentSwarm}
wildActions.text: Resolve two different unused Core Actions without an additional move. Exhaust both and add 3 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
wildActions.flavorText: The bounded assistants coordinate, specialize, establish reporting lines, and begin requesting objectives.
wildActions.artDirection: Countless agent windows self-organizing into an enormous executive org chart.
wildActions.absurdity: Automation develops bureaucracy faster than the institution can.

wildActions.name: Declare ${terms.systems.agi}
wildActions.text: If eligible, spend 3 ${terms.resources.compute}, score the declaration ${terms.resources.mandate}, and add 3 ${terms.resources.scrutiny}. The game continues.
wildActions.flavorText: A definition, a benchmark, and a financing event converge at one podium. Rivals continue taking turns.
wildActions.artDirection: A black ${terms.systems.agi} podium before a wall of disputed definitions and rapidly rising charts.
wildActions.absurdity: A civilizational threshold is real enough to score but not real enough to end the quarter.

wildActions.name: ${terms.technology.advancedGeneration}
wildActions.displayName: The Press Release Is Net Positive
wildActions.text: On ${terms.locations.grid}, spend ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.runwayCost} ${terms.resources.runway} to construct ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.power} ${terms.resources.power}, score ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.mandate} ${terms.resources.mandate}, and add ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.scrutiny} ${terms.resources.scrutiny}.
wildActions.flavorText: The device generates ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.powerWord} ${terms.resources.power}, ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.mandateWord} ${terms.resources.mandate}, and several competing definitions of breakeven.
wildActions.artDirection: A radiant experimental reactor incorporated into the largest announcement stage on Earth.
wildActions.absurdity: Fusion competes directly with ${terms.systems.agi} for the institution’s final-quarter attention.
